commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.
90+3' Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Javier Alberola Rojas no option but to blow his whistle.
90+2' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) sends a chip pass into the box, but Thibaut Courtois is quickest to intercept the ball.
90+1' What a great touch by Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom left corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
90+1' Dani Raba (Leganes) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
87' Carlo Ancelotti decides to make a substitution. Jude Bellingham will be replaced by Endrick (Real Madrid).
86' Substitution. Miguel de la Fuente will be replaced by Diego Garcia (Leganes).
85' 0 - 3 Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) gets to the rebound in the goalmouth and plants a header home.
85' Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) receives a pass and fires in a shot from the edge of the box. It deflects off one of the defending players and hits the underside of the crossbar!
85' Luka Modric (Real Madrid) will take a corner kick.
85' Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Real Madrid earn a corner.
84' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
83' Carlo Ancelotti has decided to make a change. Luka Modric (Real Madrid) replaces Kylian Mbappe.
82' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) weaves through the defence and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score.
80' The ball is out of play. Leganes will have a chance to score from a corner.
75' The substitution is prepared. Brahim Diaz (Real Madrid) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Arda Guler.
75' The game has come to an end for Adria Altimira. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Valentin Rosier (Leganes).
75' Borja Jimenez has decided to substitute Darko Brasanac and he is replaced by Sebastien Haller (Leganes).

74' Marko Dmitrovic was forced into action to thwart Arda Guler (Real Madrid). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper.
73' Adria Altimira (Leganes) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
72' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
72' Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Javier Alberola Rojas signals. Real Madrid will take a free kick.
69' Adria Altimira (Leganes) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

66' 0 - 2 Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) scores an incredible goal! He receives a pass, makes some space for himself and unleashes a long-range thunderbolt of a shot past the goalkeeper into the bottom left corner.
66' Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) takes a short free kick.

65' Dani Raba (Leganes) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Javier Alberola Rojas with no other option than to blow for a foul. Real Madrid are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
62' Adria Altimira (Leganes) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
62' PENALTY APPEAL after Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
61' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
60' The ball is cleared after Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player. Real Madrid will take a corner kick.
59' Here is a change. Munir El Haddadi is going off and Borja Jimenez gives the last tactical orders to Dani Raba (Leganes).
58' The referee signals a substitution. Julian Chicco (Leganes) is brought on as a substitute for Yvan Neyou.
58' A clumsy foul by Darko Brasanac (Leganes) and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle.
57' The free kick is taken by Arda Guler (Real Madrid), but ball is cleared.
56' Adria Altimira (Leganes) tackles a bit over-zealously and Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul.
55' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 3:9. The current number of shots on goal is 0:4.
54' Juan Cruz (Leganes) collects a pass, sees the keeper off his line and shoots from long range, but the effort is disappointing and goes high over the bar.
54' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Arda Guler (Real Madrid) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
52' Wow, what an escape. Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked.
52' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) finds himself in a promising position after receiving an excellent pass into the box, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention to avert the threat.
49' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
48' Javier Alberola Rojas interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Adria Altimira (Leganes).
48' The attendance is 12338.
47' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) sends a chip pass into the box, but Marko Dmitrovic is quickest to intercept the ball.
46' Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) sends a poor cross in from the free kick that is cleared by the head of a defender.
45+2' Antonio Rudiger (Real Madrid) is penalised for holding. Javier Alberola Rojas signals a set piece. Leganes have been awarded a free kick.
45+1' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) took a first-time shot from mid-range after he was put in the clear by a great pass, but the effort lacked a little accuracy and went just wide of the left post.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
43' 0 - 1 Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) receives the ball after one of the defenders fails to make a clearance and sends the ball into the back of the net!
41' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) receives a reproachful look from Jude Bellingham. He latches on to his pass, but the effort from the edge of the box sails high over the crossbar.
40' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Marko Dmitrovic.
39' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) sets the ball up and is ready to take the free kick from a promising distance. Many goals have been scored from this distance. Let's see what happens.
38' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) commits a rough challenge and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for an infringement. Real Madrid win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
36' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Leganes.
36' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
34' Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle and it's Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
32' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) has a go from a long way out but it sails way over.
31' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
29' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Real Madrid.
28' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Real Madrid.
27' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) is picked out by one of his teammates with a great cross, but his poor control allows the defence to clear and avert the threat.
26' A cross into the box from Fran Garcia (Real Madrid) is cleared.
25' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong.
25' What an amazing save by Marko Dmitrovic! Arda Guler (Real Madrid) swirls around the defenders and attempts to beat the keeper with a close-range shot towards the bottom left corner, but fails.
24' Juan Cruz (Leganes) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Thibaut Courtois intercepts the ball.
22' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
18' Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) dived to the ground without any contact with the opponent.
18' A long ball forward to Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) is intercepted.
16' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes the corner kick but the ball only finds the head of an opponent.
16' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked. It will be a corner kick for Real Madrid.
14' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball goes out of play and Leganes will have a goal kick.
11' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) has a goal ruled out for offside!
10' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Munir El Haddadi (Leganes), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
9' Rough tackle by Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid). The referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Leganes, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
7' Dani Ceballos (Real Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle for a foul.
5' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) goes on a mazy run through the defence and gets within shooting range inside the box, but his low effort to the middle of the target is thwarted by Marko Dmitrovic.
5' Real Madrid are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
3' The free kick will be taken by Arda Guler (Real Madrid).
3' Adria Altimira (Leganes) makes a slide tackle, but referee Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul. Real Madrid are awarded a free kick.

2' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation. It's a free kick to Real Madrid in a dangerous position.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Real Madrid will kick-off.
Javier Alberola Rojas will officiate today.
